## Cleaning schedule

| Item | After use | Every shift | Daily | Weekly | Other | Precautions e.g. wear gloves or goggles | Method of cleaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meat slicer | X |  |  |  |  | Unplug it before taking it apart, and keep fingers clear of the blade. | Take off the guard and the carriage, wash them in the sink with the kitchen detergent, and rinse them.<br>Spray every part with the sanitiser, wipe it with blue roll, and put the slicer back together once it is dry. |
| Coffee machine |  |  | X |  |  | Let it cool down before cleaning the group heads. | Run its cleaning programme with a cleaning tablet, soak the drip tray and the filter baskets in the sink, and wipe the outside with a damp cloth. |
| Drinks fridge |  |  |  |  | On the first Monday of each month | Switch it off at the wall first. | Move the drinks into the other fridges, wipe out the inside with warm soapy water and then the sanitiser, and dry it with blue roll before switching it back on. |

Agreed by:

- CS-01 Meat slicer: Priya Shah, 2026-11-17
- CS-02 Coffee machine: Sam Okafor, 2026-11-17
- CS-03 Drinks fridge: Sam Okafor, 2026-11-17
